item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"China had enacted safeguards against torture, including exclusion of torture-obtained confessions, mandatory audiovisual recording of interrogations in major cases, recognition of severe mental suffering as torture, a national anti-trafficking plan, abolition of re-education through labour, and full audiovisual recording of interrogations in major cases by 2014.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.3","3B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional background; relevant as inherited safeguards entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Measures were adopted by the Chinese state before Xi Jinping's 2023 period; the document does not attribute them personally to Xi.","limitations":["The source reports formal measures and implementation claims, not Xi's personal direction or 2023 enforcement outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that prior recommendations on torture safeguards, harassment of lawyers and human-rights defenders, statistical transparency, and accountability for events in Tibet had not yet been implemented; it also found that domestic torture provisions did not cover all elements of the Convention's definition and could leave impunity loopholes.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant as unresolved inherited exposure.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the Chinese state; it does not establish Xi Jinping's personal role or a 2023 decision.","limitations":["The observations were adopted in 2015 and do not independently establish conditions in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":8,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"The Committee found prolonged pretrial detention risks: police custody could last up to 30 days plus seven additional days before prosecutorial approval, officials reportedly used extensions up to 30 days and beyond legal limits, and prosecutorial authorities disapproved 406 arrests in 2014. It recommended prompt judicial presentation, release or remand, access to a judge, and non-custodial alternatives.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","4B.4","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited detention safeguards.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese detention institutions and officials; no personal attribution to Xi Jinping is made.","limitations":["The 406 figure is for 2014 and the source does not provide 2023 implementation data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":9,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that access to lawyers and family notification could be withheld indefinitely in cases involving state security, terrorism, serious bribery, or state secrets, and that public-security officials reportedly refused lawyer access and family notification even when detainees were not charged with state-security crimes.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited procedural safeguards.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese public-security practice and law; it does not prove Xi Jinping personally ordered these restrictions.","limitations":["Reports are historical and the source does not quantify 2023 practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":11,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"The Committee expressed grave concern that residential surveillance at a designated location could last up to six months for broadly defined security-related offenses, with families notified within 24 hours but not necessarily told the reason or place of detention, creating a risk of incommunicado detention in unregulated facilities.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited security powers.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese criminal-procedure law; it does not establish Xi Jinping's personal involvement.","limitations":["The observation predates 2023 and describes legal risk and reported practice rather than a 2023 event."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported an alleged crackdown since July 2015 involving more than 200 lawyers and activists detained or interrogated, with 25 reportedly under residential surveillance and four allegedly unaccounted for; reported abuses included broad charges, ill-treatment, torture, license revocation, and courtroom exclusion.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 event and institutional finding; relevant to inherited treatment of legal and civic actors.","ruler_attribution":"The Committee attributed the reported pattern to Chinese authorities, not specifically to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The account is based on reported allegations and predates the target year."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":13,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"The Committee found consistent reports that torture and ill-treatment remained entrenched in the criminal-justice system, that authorities relied excessively on confessions, and that public-security officers exercised excessive power without effective prosecutorial or judicial control; it also noted missing data on complaints, investigations, and sanctions.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","4B.4","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited state-violence and accountability conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese criminal-justice institutions; it does not establish Xi Jinping's personal direction.","limitations":["The Committee's evidence and data limitations prevent direct measurement of 2023 prevalence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":16,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that detention centres had implemented entry medical examinations, but officials could verify doctors' forms and doctors reported torture signs to public-security supervisors, creating conflicts of duty and pressure to suppress evidence; it also reported more than 200 lawyers and activists detained or interrogated since July 2015.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited detention oversight.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese detention and public-security authorities; no personal attribution to Xi Jinping is made.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether these arrangements persisted unchanged in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":18,"end_unit":20,"fact_summary":"The Committee found reported deaths in custody linked to torture or lack of prompt medical care, obstacles to independent autopsy and recovery of remains, absence of requested statistics on deaths and investigations, and a lack of information on prosecutorial reversals of prison medical death findings.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.9","6B.2","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited custodial-safety and accountability conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese custodial and prosecutorial institutions, not Xi Jinping personally.","limitations":["The source reports allegations and missing data rather than verified 2023 totals."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":20,"end_unit":23,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that interrogation recording was not mandatory in all cases, police selectively recorded interrogations or allegedly committed torture outside video surveillance, lawyer-client meetings were often monitored despite legal prohibition, and the State had not provided complete complaint or sanction data.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited enforcement and transparency conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese police, prosecutors, and courts; it does not attribute conduct personally to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The evidence predates 2023 and includes reported cases and institutional gaps."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":23,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported credible allegations of arbitrary detention, torture, deaths in custody, and disappearances involving Tibetans, Uyghurs, and Mongolians, and noted that China failed to provide information on 24 of 26 cited Tibetan cases.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.7","3B.9","4B.3","4B.7","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited minority-protection and accountability conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Chinese state authorities; it does not establish Xi Jinping's personal order or knowledge.","limitations":["The source is a 2015 review and does not independently establish the situation in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":24,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported continuing allegations of illegal detention in unofficial 'black jails' and other administrative detention settings, including legal-education centres, compulsory drug-treatment isolation, and psychiatric institutionalization, allegedly imposed by local police without judicial process.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited arbitrary-detention exposure.","ruler_attribution":"The allegations concern Chinese local police and administrative systems; no personal attribution to Xi Jinping is established.","limitations":["The Committee recorded reports and government denial; the source does not provide 2023 verification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":27,"end_unit":29,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that China ended the death penalty for some economic and non-lethal crimes, but lacked data to verify application, expressed concern about 24-hour shackling of death-row prisoners, and noted insufficient independent oversight of organ-removal consent.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited criminal-justice safeguards.","ruler_attribution":"The legal change and reported practices concern the Chinese state; the source does not attribute them personally to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The source does not establish 2023 application rates or oversight outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":29,"end_unit":31,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that China had not clarified whether coercive sterilization and forced abortion allegations were investigated or remedied, and that it had not clarified whether conversion therapy was prohibited, investigated, ended, or followed by redress; a Beijing court had ordered one clinic to pay compensation in 2014.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.8","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited protection and remedy conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern Chinese authorities and courts; no personal attribution to Xi Jinping is made.","limitations":["The evidence is historical and does not establish 2023 policy or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":31,"end_unit":34,"fact_summary":"The Committee welcomed China's legal provision allowing compensation for psychological harm but found that claims were statute-barred within two years and lacked information on a formal proactive rehabilitation mechanism; it urged comprehensive redress, specialized rehabilitation, and accessible services.","question_ids":["3B.4","6B.2","6B.8","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional finding; relevant to inherited remedy and welfare institutions.","ruler_attribution":"The legal framework concerns the Chinese state; Xi Jinping is not personally named.","limitations":["The source does not show whether the framework changed or was implemented in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":35,"end_unit":36,"fact_summary":"The Committee requested that China provide follow-up information by December 2016 on lawyer access, the crackdown on lawyers and activists, independent torture investigations, state-secrecy provisions, and missing data, and requested the next periodic report by December 2019.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","7B.2","7B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Pre-2023 procedural finding; indicates formal international review and pending reporting obligations.","ruler_attribution":"The obligations were directed to China, not personally to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["A request for information is not evidence that China implemented the recommendations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-73b01ab143bb05a8","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty establishes a prohibition on nuclear test explosions, requires States Parties to prohibit and prevent such explosions under their jurisdiction or control, and creates an international organization for implementation and verification.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"General treaty framework; not evidence of a Xi Jinping action during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The text is a multilateral treaty and does not attribute conduct to Xi Jinping or China in 2023.","limitations":["The supplied units state obligations but do not establish China's ratification, compliance, or Xi's decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-73b01ab143bb05a8","start_unit":7,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The CTBT framework requires national implementation measures, national authorities, objective and least-intrusive verification, cooperation with monitoring and inspections, and equal access to and obligations under verification.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.4","1B.7","1B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"General treaty framework; not evidence of a 2023 Chinese implementation decision.","ruler_attribution":"The treaty assigns duties to States Parties and international bodies, without identifying Xi Jinping's conduct.","limitations":["The units do not show whether China implemented these requirements in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-73b01ab143bb05a8","start_unit":18,"end_unit":19,"fact_summary":"The CTBT Protocol specifies international monitoring infrastructure, including Chinese seismic, radionuclide, and infrasound facilities, and provides for International Data Centre processing, reporting, equal data access, and operational-failure notification.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.4","1B.7"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Treaty infrastructure and station listings; not a 2023 Xi Jinping event.","ruler_attribution":"China is listed as responsible for facilities, but the text does not identify Xi Jinping's role or 2023 performance.","limitations":["Station listings and treaty provisions do not establish operational status or Chinese compliance during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3b31605752d9c2ef","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The UN Treaty Body Database records that China ratified the Convention against Torture in 1988 and that the Convention entered into force for China in November 1988.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.10","7B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Historical treaty status carried into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The ratification predates Xi Jinping and is attributed to China as a State Party, not to Xi personally.","limitations":["Ratification alone does not demonstrate 2023 implementation or compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3b31605752d9c2ef","start_unit":426,"end_unit":427,"fact_summary":"The UN Treaty Body Database records that China did not accept the Convention against Torture's Article 20 inquiry procedure; the recorded non-acceptance date is 4 October 1988.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical treaty oversight position carried into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The non-acceptance is recorded for China and predates Xi Jinping; it is not a personal 2023 decision by Xi.","limitations":["The database entry does not explain the rationale or establish whether the position changed during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3b31605752d9c2ef","start_unit":93,"end_unit":96,"fact_summary":"The UN Treaty Body Database records China's ninth CEDAW periodic-report cycle, including a State Party reply submitted in March 2023, civil-society submissions in April 2023, and concluding observations published in June 2023.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.7","6B.3","6B.8","7B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2023 reporting and review activity.","ruler_attribution":"The records concern China's State Party reporting process; they do not establish Xi Jinping's personal authorship or implementation of any recommendation.","limitations":["The supplied page lists documents and dates but not their substantive findings or implementation outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3b31605752d9c2ef","start_unit":248,"end_unit":284,"fact_summary":"The UN Treaty Body Database records China's 2023 ICESCR review cycle, including civil-society submissions in January 2023, a February 2023 dialogue, and concluding observations published in March 2023.","question_ids":["5B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2023 reporting and review activity.","ruler_attribution":"The records concern China's State Party review process and do not establish Xi Jinping's personal conduct or the substantive content of the recommendations.","limitations":["The supplied page provides process metadata rather than the underlying evidence or findings."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-6d66d1ff6d2d8dc7"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied evidence is largely historical or institutional and often predates 2023; it does not support direct attribution of most findings to Xi Jinping personally.","The two treaty-body country-page sources are substantially duplicated; duplicated records were not emitted twice.","The CTBT text is a general treaty instrument and station listing, not evidence of China's 2023 compliance or Xi Jinping's decisions."]}
